pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to losing positions or executing multiple orders within a 3-pip band to prevent compounding drawdowns during flash wicks.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Order execution is strictly blocked unless the order book imbalance confirms directional momentum and ATR expansion exceeds the 14-period moving average.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops and partial profit sweeps as soon as the trade reaches +$15.00, ensuring winners naturally run to the $15-$30+ target zone.
